source.text:
When a scheduled job stops quietly, I'm the one who notices.

When a webhook fires twice, I make sure it counts once.

When the on-call engineer sleeps through the alert, my product calls the next one.

Location: (IST, UTC+5:30)

Remote: Yes, remote only. I can cover full EU working hours and overlap with US mornings.

Willing to relocate: No

Technologies: TypeScript, Node.js, React, Next.js, PostgreSQL (Supabase, row-level security), Redis/Bull, Docker, Linux, GitHub Actions, AWS S3, Stripe, webhooks, FFmpeg, some Python

Résumé/CV: https://www.linkedin.com/in/harjobandeep-singh (PDF on request)

Email: harjobandeepsingh35 [at] gmail [dot] com

Full-stack developer, 2+ years at GIF Studios / Persist Ventures (joined as an intern, now with team-lead duties).

- Viapoie (https://viapoie.com): voice-first incident response I built and launched solo last month. About 24k lines of TypeScript on Next.js and Postgres, uptime checks every minute, an escalation roster that calls the next person.

- At work: Node.js background jobs with health monitoring, Postgres with row-level security, Stripe billing. I cut one media workflow's running cost from about $700-800 to $115 a month.

- Cloutso (https://cloutso.com): a product I built at GIF Studios, from my own proposal to production.

Looking for a full-time or contract role on a small, async-friendly team: full-stack, backend or product engineering.
